config.label: Optional Ticketmaster Discovery API key — adds concerts/sports/theater to dfw_events
config.description: Optional Ticketmaster Discovery API key — adds concerts/sports/theater to dfw_events. Free (5000 calls/day) at https://developer.ticketmaster.com. City calendars work without it.

config.label: Optional Socrata app token — raises the shared per-IP rate limit for Dallas open-data queries
config.description: Optional Socrata app token — raises the shared per-IP rate limit for Dallas open-data queries. Free at https://dev.socrata.com/register. Works fine without it.
